description: Rohdaten BfG-GNSS-Messnetz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by igs.bkg.bund.de. The BfG-GNSS measuring network consists of more than 50 GNSS stations in the North Sea and Baltic Sea. The primary purpose is the georeferencing of waterway and shipping administration (WSV) levels. The raw data includes the continuous observation data of the satellite systems GPS, Glonass, Galileo and Beidou. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Raw data BfG-GNSS measuring network" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TGFO, LTA2, TGLE, GWES, TGW2, TGDA. The listing shows 2025-11-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
